vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in pairs of the same color combination (i.e the brown gnome always appears with the pink). Each one of the gnomes in the pair has either a yellow or a red basket when getting the mushrooms. Try to remember which colour gnome has which colour basket (i.e brown gnome has yellow basket, and pink gnome has red). The highest number of mushrooms comes from the same colour basket each time, but they sometimes switch, so keep an eye.
